errors.evidence: A well-known fact is that Barack Obama was born in Honolulu, Hawaii, which is in the extreme west (longitude ≈ 157°W). On the eastern side among presidential birthplaces, one can note that both John Adams and John Quincy Adams were born in the Massachusetts area – specifically in Quincy, Massachusetts (with longitude roughly −71°W), which is the closest to the prime meridian among those cities.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumed that Honolulu and Quincy are the farthest apart cities based on incorrect longitude values.
